home.description: Engineer-trained patent attorneys connect prosecution, disputes, valuation and value realisation in one team.
home.heroTitle:
Filing is the beginning.
Value realisation is the goal.
home.heroLede: Our engineer-trained patent attorneys understand the technology first. One team carries the matter from filing through disputes, valuation and realisation.
home.panel: Start with the path that fits the purpose of your rights.
home.startBody: Cross-border matters are rarely simple. For Korean work or multi-jurisdiction portfolios, we work alongside your team from strategy through execution.

entries.title: Companies & R&D
entries.body: We structure domestic and international filings, registration, dispute response and value realisation around each stage of the business.

entries.title: Foreign associates · Korean matters
entries.body: Complex Korean matters do not need to be handled alone. A responsible attorney who understands MOIP standards and local procedure works as an extension of your team, from strategy through reporting.

entries.title: Korean IP firms · Global matters
entries.body: For demanding multi-jurisdiction matters, we coordinate country strategy, trusted local counsel, translation and deadlines as an extension of your international team.

home.aboutTitle:
Near to our clients.
Wise in strategy.
home.aboutLead: Obtaining a right is not the end. The goal is to make it work for the business.
home.aboutBody: The attorney in charge works with you from start to finish. We preserve the technical context, read the business stage and competitive landscape, and design both the right protection method and the route to value realisation.
home.quote: Registration is only the start. We make rights work in the business.

home.servicesBody: Each stage informs the next. Experience in transactions and exits changes how rights should be designed from day one.

services.title: Secure
services.body: Korean patent, utility model, design and trademark filing and registration, including office-action strategy.

services.title: Defend
services.body: Infringement analysis, opinions, design-arounds, warning-letter response, trials and litigation—before a dispute hardens.

services.title: Expand
services.body: PCT and national filings, specification translation and collaboration with trusted foreign associates in market-entry order.

services.title: Realise
services.body: Valuation, sale-oriented portfolio design, technology-listing review and IP-backed finance. Registration is not the finish line.

services.title: MOIP practice
services.body: The responsible attorney handles Korean filings, prosecution, trials and disputes with close attention to MOIP standards, procedures and local practice, while coordinating directly with foreign associates.

services.title: Overseas patent annuities
services.body: We monitor country-specific deadlines and costs, then coordinate payment through trusted local counsel so overseas patents remain in force.

services.title: Overseas trademark renewals
services.body: We track renewal windows and local document requirements across jurisdictions so valuable trademark registrations do not lapse.
